pages.title: Pattern
pages.text:
**Clock.** Create. Water wheels, presses, mixers, belts — one cog, then the same cog again.\
The precision mechanism wants a Binding Knot at its heart. That is the Loom asking to be included.

pages.title: Before you move on
pages.text:
Finish Clock. Claim the token and seat it. The Clock notch lights.\
Read **Start here** for worked examples. Recipes live in JEI; the **Spirit Codex** covers Tribal Power machinery. If you get stuck, test one recipe at a time and sneak-use the Spirit Codex on a silent machine.
